name: CVEL: Shuttle-A ice mining, Tranquility Base
description: A CVEL Shuttle-A landed at Tranquility Base on the Moon with its water tank nearly empty. The Moon is poor in water, so mining is slow: press Resource processing: start in the Ship systems window (F1) and use time warp. Compare with the Deltaglider at Gale Crater, where the ground is wetter.
